content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR CEERI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR CEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the CSIR-Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute (CSIR CEERI), located in Pilani, Rajasthan, for various temporary project-based positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in CSIR CEERI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available for positions including PAT-I, PAT-II, Project Assistant-I, Project Assistant-II, and Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the advertised project staff positions is 14 October 2026 (with notification date 28 September 2026).

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualifications are required for these posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications range from 10th with ITI, Diploma, B.Sc, B.E/B.Tech, M.Sc, to ME/M.Tech or equivalent depending upon the specific post code and project requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is typically set at 30 to 35 years depending on the post category, with age relaxations provided for reserved category candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 18,000/- up to Rs. 37,000/- per month based on their designated post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification released by CSIR-CEERI for these project staff and research positions.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial screening of applications by a Standing Screening Committee followed by an Online Interview conducted via Microsoft Teams.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official CSIR-CEERI web portal by following the detailed instructions provided on their recruitment page.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF, application portal link, and official website references directly through the Important Links section in this article.
